note: Creature template for flying species (zephyrit, cindermoth). A body core along Y with a head, a two-bone tail or abdomen and two wings of two bones each. The creature hovers: every airborne clip lifts the body by gait.hoverPx while the root stays on the ground anchor (L2); sleep and downed land it. Legs, if any, ride with the body. Protected spec: change under DOC-5.

orientation.autoOrient: none: the wingspan defeats a PCA long axis, so the mesh keeps the sheet's front view facing -Y (as humans). Recipe rig.yawDeg overrides.

landmarks.note: Detected from the front-facing mesh. Fractions of the half-span (|x| from the centre line): the body core is |x| < coreFraction; the wing root, middle and tip are the mean of the wing vertices in rootBand, midBand and beyond tipFraction. Head and tail regions are fractions of the core's length. A recipe may override any landmark with model-space [x, y, z] under rig.landmarks: hip, chest, head_base, snout, crown, tail_1, tail_2, back_top, wing_l_root/mid/tip, wing_r_root/mid/tip.

weights.proxyBasis: largest dimension (span); thin wings need a finer proxy than the body height gives
weights.fallback: nearest bone segment for proxy vertices heat weighting leaves empty

gait.hoverNote: Airborne clips lift the body this many art pixels; QA measures the idle height as heightArtPx + hoverPx.

idle.note: Two slow beats in six frames: wings up (beatDeg[0]) on frames 1-2, level, down (beatDeg[1]) on 4-5; the body rises 1 px on the downstroke. idleFlicker is a soft check: a hovering idle moves more pixels than a standing one.

gait.foldNote: Folded wings (sleep, eat, drink) sweep back this far about the vertical and lie low.
